# Lanky — Olanrewaju Okesooto for Ibadan Southwest / Northwest

> Official campaign website of Olanrewaju Okesooto ("Lanky"), Labour Party
> candidate for the Federal House of Representatives, Ibadan Southwest /
> Northwest Federal Constituency, Oyo State, Nigeria. Campaign slogan:
> "Innovation for Ibadan: Securing Our Future, Together."

Lanky, known as "The Bridge-Builder," is a community leader and technology
consultant running on a platform of digital empowerment, education, and
accountable, project-driven representation. The agenda centers on five pillars:
a Digital Town Hall app connecting residents to their representative, a
Technology & Innovation Hub training youths for global remote work, robotics and
coding in public schools, support for traders and small businesses, and a
Grooming Hub Initiative.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://votelanky.com/): Overview, vision, and the five pillars.
- [About](https://votelanky.com/about): Biography, values, and background of Olanrewaju Okesooto.
- [Manifesto](https://votelanky.com/manifesto): Full campaign agenda and the five policy pillars.
- [Wards & Local Government](https://votelanky.com/wards): Focus across Ibadan SW/NW LGAs and how to verify your INEC polling unit.
- [News & Media](https://votelanky.com/news): Press releases, campaign updates, and ward-to-ward tour coverage.
- [Get Involved](https://votelanky.com/get-involved): Volunteer roles — canvassing, advocacy, polling-unit agents, events.
- [Donate](https://votelanky.com/donate): Secure contributions for supporters in Nigeria and the diaspora.
- [Contact](https://votelanky.com/contact): WhatsApp, email, campaign office, and the campaign team.

## Facts

- Candidate: Olanrewaju Okesooto (Lanky)
- Office sought: Federal House of Representatives
- Constituency: Ibadan Southwest / Northwest Federal Constituency, Oyo State, Nigeria
- Party: Labour Party
- Guiding principle: Representation Through Collaboration, Progress Through Innovation, and Development Through Collective Action.
